# Load the data
```{r}
load("./data/ratings.Rdata")
```

# Listing the data
```{r}
ls()
```

# Structure of rating
```{r}
str(ratings)
```

# Dimension
```{r}
dim(ratings)
# Number of row
nrow(ratings)
# Number of columns
ncol(ratings)

```

# Summary of rating
```{r}
summary(ratings$rating)
rating <- ratings$rating
```


# Plot
```{r}
plot(rating, xlab="Rating", main = "Plot of rating")
```

# Mean
```{r}
mean(rating)
```

# Range
```{r}
range(rating)
```

# Median
```{r}
median(rating)
```

# 1st Quartile
```{r}
quantile(rating, 0.25)
```

# 3rd Quartile
```{r}
quantile(rating, 0.75)
```

# Box-Plot
```{r}
boxplot(rating, col = "red", main = "Box Plot")
```

# QQ-Plot
```{r}
qqnorm(rating)
```

# Ploting Profit per Capital
```{r}
plot(ratings$profit, rating, xlab="Profit", ylab="Rating", col="blue" ,
ylim = c(-3, 80),
xlim = c(0, 12)
)
```

# Scatter Plot Matrix
```{r}
pairs(ratings)
```
